Title: Register new customer with valid details
Preconditions: User is not logged in; open Toolshop home
Steps:
1. Open Sign in > Register
2. Enter valid first/last name DOB address (include house number) phone email password
3. Click Register
ExpectedResult: User is registered and redirected to login (or authenticated state). No validation errors.

Title: Login with registered credentials
Steps:
1. Open Sign in
2. Enter registered email/password
3. Click Login
ExpectedResult: User lands in account area; nav menu shows user name; Sign in replaced by account menu.

Title: Login with invalid password
Steps:
1. Open Sign in
2. Enter email with wrong password
3. Click Login
ExpectedResult: Login fails; error message shown; user remains unauthenticated.

Title: Browse catalog and open product details
Steps:
1. Verify product cards on home
2. Open an in-stock product
3. Verify name price quantity controls
ExpectedResult: Product detail shows name price add-to-cart; out-of-stock products disable purchase path.

Title: Add multiple items and update quantity
Steps:
1. Open product
2. Increase quantity to 2
3. Add to cart
4. Open cart
ExpectedResult: Cart quantity badge = 2; cart line shows product and updated qty/line price.

Title: Checkout with Cash on Delivery and double Confirm for invoice
Preconditions: Logged-in user with items in cart
Steps:
1. Cart > Proceed (sign-in step) > Proceed (address)
2. Ensure billing address valid including house number (TG / 1234AA / Zoey Shore)
3. Proceed to payment
4. Select Cash on Delivery
5. Click Confirm once (payment success)
6. Click Confirm again (invoice generation)
7. Open My Invoices
ExpectedResult: First confirm shows Payment was successful; second confirm shows Thanks for your order with INV-*; invoice listed under My Invoices.

Title: Verify profile information after login
Steps:
1. Open account menu
2. Open My Profile
3. Review name email address fields

Title: Prevent checkout when cart is empty
Steps:
1. Open cart with no items
2. Attempt proceed/checkout
ExpectedResult: User cannot complete payment/invoice; empty-cart messaging or disabled proceed path.
